theoryContent:
Rigid Body Dynamics about a Fixed Axis:
1. Moment of inertia (I) represents rotational inertia and depends on mass distribution relative to the rotational axis.
2. Fundamental equation τ = Iα is the rotational counterpart of Newton's second law (F = ma).
3. As the string unwinds, the gravitational potential energy of the falling mass (mgh) converts into both translational kinetic energy (½mv²) and rotational kinetic energy (½Iω²).
4. For equal mass and radius, hoops have the highest inertia (I = MR²) and accelerate slower than disks and solid spheres.
